description: This file defines the EmployeeAttendanceSummaryListModel class, which is part of the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin API. It models and serializes a list of employee attendance summary records, providing methods for converting internal data to an array suitable for API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceSummaryListModel
classes.description: Models and serializes a list of employee attendance summaries, implementing collection normalization and constructor argument awareness.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an array of employee attendance summary records.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the internal records into an array suitable for API serialization, computing hours, minutes, and formatted label.
